name: browser-use
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 2a14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0 20 14.5 14.5 0 0 0 0-20"/><path d="M2 12h20"/></svg>
description: 常驻 Chrome 自动化与全能智能搜索：支持无头静默运行与实体窗口切换、受后台任务面板精确管理；单一 browser_use 工具同时承载搜索（action="search"，标签页隔离、无图极速渲染、搜阅一体、时效过滤、官网认证置顶、域名多样性、真实落地页并发还原与智能降级）与页面交互、read_page 纯净阅读以及控制台日志实时捕获（Console）。
descriptionEn: Persistent Chrome automation & smart search: headless mode, background tasks; one browser_use tool covering action=search, page interaction, console log inspection, and read_page clean extraction.

settings.label: 无头模式 (Headless)
settings.hint: 开启后浏览器在后台静默运行不弹出窗口；关闭后会显示实体 Chrome 桌面窗口
settings.hintEn: Run Chrome silently in background without GUI window; disable to display desktop Chrome window

settings.label: 闲置自动关闭（分钟）
settings.hint: 浏览器无任何操作达到该时长后自动关闭以释放内存；设为 0 表示永不自动关闭
settings.hintEn: Automatically close the browser to release RAM when idle for this duration; set to 0 to disable

settings.label: 默认搜索引擎 (Default Engine)
settings.hint: 未显式指定搜索引擎时的默认首选项；遇验证码或反爬会自动按降级链重试
settings.hintEn: Default preferred engine when unspecified; automatically falls back on error/captcha

settings.label: 极速搜索模式 (Fast Search)
settings.hint: 搜索时通过 CDP 阻断图片、字体与媒体资源下载，页面毫秒级解析，大幅节省宽带与耗时
settings.hintEn: Block images, fonts and media during search via CDP for sub-second SERP extraction

settings.label: 搜索标签页隔离 (Tab Isolation)
settings.hint: 在后台专用标签页执行搜索，不打扰或覆盖您当前前台正在浏览交互的网页
settings.hintEn: Perform web search in dedicated worker tab without hijacking or reloading active user tab
